game.name: Dead Or Alive 5 Ultimate (World)
game.desc: Dead or Alive 5 Ultimate is a fighting game for Xbox 360. It is a re-release of Dead or Alive 5 with some additions. You will find 5 additional characters: Momiji, Rachel, Ein, Leon and Jacky Bryant. The gameplay has also undergone some readjustments for the occasion and new moves have appeared. The title also includes new tutorials.
